data.title: SpoGomi: Machi no Kizunazukuri-hen
data.title_japanese: スポGOMI まちの絆づくり編
data.synopsis:
Although several years have passed since the SpoGomi exhibition match, recognition of the sport in Japan remains low. Akari and Tokio visited various places and worked to spread SpoGomi. Meanwhile, it has been decided that the SpoGomi World Cup will be held near Okawa, a river in a certain city.

(Source: U-NEXT, translated)

data.synopsis:
